verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a coding agent that can pull in a tracked issue through an MCP tracker integration (the docs show `grok mcp add` for Linear). It can then plan, edit and run work in an isolated worktree, monitor CI, and run headless for automation. However, nothing in the evidence shows it creating branches, commits or pull requests, so the issue-to-PR flow has to be assembled from separate pieces. Missing for 10: documented PR creation or GitHub/GitLab integration, an issue-to-PR workflow guide, commit/push handling, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end run.
